current_source: implementation/*.py are current final source; each runs/*/EXECUTED_SOURCE records exact launched source independently. Earlier PREPARED/source pin manifests remain historical, not overwritten.
launch: implementation/dispatch.py copies source into create-only run/EXECUTED_SOURCE and launches saved script with --unit <unit> --output <run> --run-id <id>,cwd=EXECUTED_SOURCE.
module_import: primary.py imports rr_engine from launched EXECUTED_SOURCE. rr_engine.provider(unit) loads unit/inputs/reused/c23b/spectral_photo_source.py with importlib and instantiates Verner96.from_table(HI,path.parent/data). It consumes point evaluations only.
private_inputs: C5/source caller needs private immutable unit/inputs/reused/pr104/*.npz, c23d/ATOMS_*.csv and c23b/data/verner_photo.dat from authorized checkpoint. Public source repository intentionally omits those bytes; INPUT_MANIFEST pins exact sizes/SHA256.
controls: Provider module plain import does not create old quadrature nodes. REI li_thermal_rates.py not imported; no thermal quadrature replay.
lineage: Copied immutable inputs are local copies of prior admitted evidence; new consumer source and results distinct.
